device_offline.title: {name} is offline
device_offline.description:
The FGLair cloud reports that the WiFi adapter of **{name}** (`{dsn}`) is offline, so it can't be controlled.

Check that the unit has power and that its WiFi adapter can reach your router. You can confirm in the FGLair app. This message disappears automatically when the unit reconnects.
